title: Categories - Harwich Artwork - The Guild of Harwich Artists
bodyHtml:
Thursday Open Paint

Held Thursdays at the Harwich Community Center, 100 Oak St., Harwich from 1 – 4 pm. Open to current Guild of Harwich Artists members.

For Art and The Community

The Guild of Harwich Artists, Inc. is a non-profit 501(c)3 organization that encourages artists and those interested in art through education, fellowship, and exhibitions, and to engage in charitable works that benefit Harwich residents. Membership is open to all residents and taxpayers in Barnstable County.
